problem: A sealed v8 receipt cannot be verified against its sources without a hand-written script, correlation between Flow grants, MAF checkpoints and provider sessions breaks at the manager, and no token budget bounds a lineage.
intended_users: Andy, auditing attempts from the CLI.
The Shaper, sealing a token budget and headroom.
outcomes: flow run trace shows the full per-call chain; flow run verify-receipt verifies a sealed receipt offline block by block; a sealed lineage token budget is enforced before every paid grant, with tranche expansion and honest overshoot.
scope: Manager provider identity, manager request files, grant-history events, call-tagged process groups, checkpoint chain, required recovery actor, flow run trace, sealed token budget and tranche expansion, charged-usage accounting, pre-grant token check, receipt token block, full-row seal comparison, flow run verify-receipt, ADR 0020 and docs.
exclusions: Per-call token caps or mid-call cancel.
Re-running tests, re-applying diffs, or worktree-drift checks.
constraints: The ledger and existing fences stay authoritative; lock order unchanged.
assumptions: Claude cache fields are disjoint from input; Codex cached input is a subset of input.

risks.risk: verify-receipt drifts from the seal logic
overshoot larger than documented under concurrency or unknown sends
token defaults calibrated on one live lineage
